programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: Cameras capture an entire city floating in the sky; a signal comes from under a tiny island off the coast of Africa; a powerful radio beam from deep space reaches Earth only to vanish and never return.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: In 1950, physicist Enrico Fermi famously asked, "Where is everybody?"; in such a vast universe, how could life exist only on Earth? This existential query has fueled decades of debate, conjuring visions of alien worlds.

programs.title: Digital Tsunami: Big Tech, Big AI, Big Brother
programs.desc: This documentary will examine how toxic elements of digital environment are dramatically transforming society in negative ways, just as the prophetic, popular futurist Marshall McLuhan predicted 60 years ago. Examining the unforeseen social and political problems caused by the digital revolution, and highlight the need for laws and regulations to protect citizens, especially the most vulnerable.

programs.title: Deadly Science
programs.desc: Innovators throughout history have pushed human ingenuity to the edge; Lilienthal pioneered flight, Abakovsky's high-speed train derailed tragically, and Bullock's printing press revolutionized publishing, yet these advancements came at a high cost.

programs.title: Pharaohs: Rise & Fall
programs.desc: The Ramessides rise to become some of the most powerful pharaohs in Egyptian history; but, a civil war ignited by a power vacuum threatens to destabilize an empire.

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: A secret military base around the North Pole; a man-made, ancient stone formation below the surface of Lake Huron; a 1500-year-old burial ground on the shores of the Baltic Sea; a life form in the permafrost in Russia's far east.

programs.title: Cursed Histories
programs.sub_title: Timur's Tomb, Curse of the Ninth, The Lost City of Frenier
programs.desc: A neglected warning inside a mighty conqueror's tomb; a jinxed number traps a string of composers; a southern healer is said to possess magic so powerful that she summons mother nature to submerge a town in the depths of a swamp.

programs.title: Colossal Machines
programs.desc: In April 1981, the first Space Shuttle launched, ushering in a new era of space exploration; unlocking the secrets of the cosmos requires intricate machines, and what's under their hood is nothing short of rocket science.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: A team of experts breaks down significant disasters in history, including the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, the Suez Canal blockage, the California wildfires of 2020, the 1970 Yungay, Peru, avalanche, and the bombings of Hiroshima.
